ios.desc:
Your potential customers or users are already talking about what you offer on Reddit. They are asking questions, comparing tools, sharing pain points, and looking for better ways to solve problems.

Community Ninja finds those moments for you.

Describe what you offer, choose the communities you care about, and Community Ninja scans Reddit for relevant opportunities. Each post & comment is matched semantically first, then based on its real intent. It is then ranked, explained, and turned into something you can act on.

What you can do:

• Discover real-postive-intent Reddit posts and comments
• See why each opportunity matched
• Spot people asking for help, tools, advice, or alternatives
• Save, hide, or report results
• Draft helpful replies before you engage
• Open the original Reddit thread for full context
• Get alerts when strong opportunities appear

This is not a spam bot. Community Ninja does not auto-comment, auto-DM, vote, or post without you. You stay in control.

Use it to find potential customers, research your market, monitor communities, discover pain points, and show up when your answer actually fits.

Stop guessing where your users are.

Find the conversations already asking for you.
